facts.statement: At 31 March 2026, the Group had available C 169.17 Crores of undrawn committed borrowing facilities.
facts.quote: At 31 March 2026, the Group had available C 169.17 Crores (31st March, 2025: C 407.99 Crores) of undrawn committed borrowing facilities.

facts.statement: Total current borrowings as of 31st March, 2026 were C 965.27 Crores.
Operating segments are reported consistently with internal reporting provided to the Managing Director as chief operating decision maker.

facts.statement: The group primarily operates on a cash and carry business model.
facts.quote: The group operates on business model of primarily cash and carry and credit risk from receivable perspective is not significant.
